notes.title: 1.12 Harve Patch Update – New Features, Fixes, and More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We’re sorry for the silence — life caught up with us, but we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes on our next project and some love for Harve! This small but meaningful content update addresses some long-standing feedback from the community, lays the groundwork for future updates, and brings a couple of exciting new features.

Fixes:


 Resolved several annoying camera glitches
 Fixed an issue preventing save files from being deleted
 Confirming a save now properly closes the popup window
 Fixed many items not saving correctly
 Costs now reset properly when deleting a save
 Adjusted camera bounds on certain maps for smoother play


New Additions:


 New Level-Up Menu
 A fresh level-up screen now showcases a 3D display of all the items you’ve unlocked. 
 Community-Voted Animal: The Meerkat

You voted, we listened. Say hello to the newest member of your ecosystem — the playful meerkat.

As always, thank you for your continued support and feedback. More updates are on the way, and we’re excited to share what’s next. In the meantime, hop in and check out the new additions!

Best,
Lunar Studios

notes.title: Harve 1.1
notes.content:
Harve 1.1 Changelog

🌟 New Features

 New Map: Island – Explore a vibrant new map to expand your creativity!
 Terrain Editor – Added a terrain editor for more control over your ecosystem designs.
 4 New Trees – Enrich your ecosystem with 4 new palm trees!
 Improved Loading Screen –Added random backgrounds and new loading bar.
 SOME New Achievements – Added a few achievements mainly for testing! 


🛠️ Improvements

 Re-Introduced Outlines to Animals – Outlines have been added back for better visibility.
 Optimized Spawning UI Buttons – Faster and smoother UI interactions during gameplay.
 Improved Load Times and Main Menu Performance – Reduced delays and improved overall responsiveness.
 Improved Tutorial Fluidity – Streamlined tutorial experience for better onboarding.
 All Levels Now Start in the Morning – Levels now begin at sunrise to enhance gameplay flow.
 Improved Steam Integration – Enhancements for a better Steam experience like achievements and rich presence.
 Marginally improved saving performance!


🐛 Bug Fixes

 Fixed Stutter When Saving – Smoother gameplay during save operations.
 Fixed Default Values Not Working – Resolved issues with default cost values not loading correctly.
 Previous Achievements Fixed – Resolved issues with previously unlocked legacy achievements.
 Fixed Camera Clipping in Certain Spots – Improved camera behavior for a more immersive experience.
 Polished Out Save Bugs – Addressed various save-related issues for a more stable experience.
 Fixed Saving Issues on Puddle – Resolved specific saving issues on Puddle levels.


Thank you for playing Harve and continuing to support its growth! Dive into the new features and updates, and don’t forget to participate in our 1.1 Screenshot Competition for your chance to win! 🌳

notes.title: Harve 1.0 Day 1 Patch
notes.content:
Thanks to the incredible feedback from our community, we’ve been able to address some minor bugs and make a few tweaks to enhance your Harve experience. Here’s what’s been fixed and added:


 Fixed terrain bounds on "Hill" level: No more wandering beyond the intended play area.
 Unlocked screen issue resolved: The unlock screen now correctly appears when you unlock new content.
 Tutorial is no longer set as the default level: You’ll now start from the main menu instead of the tutorial after loading the game.
 Fixed rare save error: Resolved an issue where the game would occasionally grant players a random amount of resources upon starting.
 Added a "Next Level Unlocked" screen: When players complete their current level, a clear and satisfying “Next Level Unlocked” screen will now appear.


We are committed to improving Harve and look forward to your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: HARVE 1.0 AVAILABLE
notes.content:
Welcome to Harve! Here you can create your own interactive ecosystem sandbox. 

New Features:

 New Menu Screen
 Remastered Field
 Added New Levels
 Added GOAT
 Added Flamingo
 New Rotation System: Revamped rotation and move systems for objects.
 Fauna Unlock System: Unlock and discover different types of animals as you progress.
 Flora Unlock System: New plants to unlock and enhance your ecosystem.
 Balance Overhaul: Improved balancing to make the game more fun and challenging.
 HUD Toggle Option: A new feature allowing players to toggle the HUD on and off.
 Added Save Confirmation Panel
 Graphical and Audio Improvements:
 Improved SFX System
 Improved Grass Detail
 Improved UI Animations
 Improved Day-Night Cycle
 Updated Music with Remastered Tracks
 Weather System Overhaul: Upgraded weather system and transitions.
 Weather Impact Effects: Rain and other weather conditions now affect terrain.
 New level "Puddle".
 Upgraded to Unity 6 and URP: Enhanced graphics and performance with Unity’s latest engine.

Gameplay Improvements:

 Improved Save System: Major enhancements to the save system for a smoother experience.
 Fixed UI Locking On Start: Addressed UI issues during game start.
 Improved Colliders on Palm Trees: Better object interaction with new trees.
 Can Move and Delete Props/Flora: Players can now move and delete already placed items.
 Massive Performance Improvements: Optimizations for better game performance across platforms.
 Improved Rotation and Move System: Enhanced precision and usability for moving objects.
 Improved Night Lighting: Updated lighting for nighttime gameplay.
 Improved Horse, Deer, and Rabbit Animations: Smoother animations for various animals.

Bug Fixes and Tweaks:


 Fixed Resolution Settings
 Fixed UI Settings
 Fixed Level Bar: Improved leveling system and UI clarity.
 Fixed UI Locking Issue on Start
 Fixed Index
 Weather Sounds Now Work Under SFX Slider
 Audio Settings Now Load on Start
 Miscellaneous Updates:
 Save Icon Added During Auto Save
 Added Index Description Panel
 Level Up Screen: New level-up screen for better progression clarity.

notes.title: 1.0 Test!
notes.content:
It's almost here! The 1.0 release for Harve is right around the corner. We just couldn't wait to share what we have done over the months, so we decided to make this test build public! This update features many core changes, new features, and a TON of bug fixes. 

Improvements:
-Terrain movements to “Pond”
-Overhauled requirement panel
-UI is more consistent
-Stats now save and load
-Animals match the surface rotation of the terrain 
-Items are now purchased with a single click instead of double
-Animals now have a larger wonder zone (Expect some more action!) 
-Improved the level select UI
-Added icons on the description panel 

Fixes:
-Description panel scale bug
-AI pathfinding on “Pond”
-Deleting the save would not reset all the cost values 
-Place impact on rocks not working after initially placed
-Place impact of flowers not working at all
-Flowers are now selectable
-Fixed often not being able to place flowers at all

New Features:
-New level and XP system 
-Level requirements for objects
-Fauna progression (plant requirements for animals)
-Day-night cycle
-Dynamic weather
-Time system (Keeps track of days, years, and seasons)

Core Changes:
-Health system removed
-World saturation removed
-New worlds (levels) unlock at level 6
-Many cost changes
-Changes RPS to 3

Best, 

Lunar Studios.
